note: The SOFT tolerance_bands below are hand-authored DEFAULTS (generous). When calibration.json is present (written by `verify-install --calibrate`), the runner overlays its per-host-calibrated bands on top of these. A SOFT miss is DRIFT and never fails the install; HARD metrics (the bit-exact canaries + binary/load liveness) gate the verdict.

severity_legend.HARD: bit-exact or binary/load liveness; a miss FAILs the demo
severity_legend.SOFT: tolerance band; in band -> PASS, in drift_band -> DRIFT, beyond -> FAIL

demos.subsystem: Newton backend RESOLUTION (did Newton actually drive the world), multi-body dynamics
demos.comment: CHANGED 2026-08-08. The band used to read {"ode": {"skip": true}} and the predicate used to pass on resolved_backend == 'ode', because resolved_backend() returned 'ode' for any run with no 'world finalised' line. src/ode was DELETED (bdc02139): there is no supported ODE host any more, so that band made THE ONLY CHECK NAMED AFTER BACKEND RESOLUTION unable to fail on a run where Newton never drove the world -- it SKIPped the HARD metric and reported PASS. resolved_backend() now returns 'unverified' there and this band FAILs it. duration_s raised 20 -> 45 first, because the honest cause of a missing finalise line is usually a too-short run (AGENTS.md: >=15 s locally, >=45 s on slow/virtualized disks) and a false FAIL would be its own lie.

demos.pass_predicate: all SOFT/INFO; a harness hiccup makes the demo SKIP, never FAIL
demos.comment: Bands calibrated from a single dev-box reference run (brightness ~59, displacement ~6 m over a 6 s free-run). Displacement is wall-clock-coarse on purpose (proves the robot is being driven), so the band is generous; harden with N=3 multi-host in CI.
